Container.Name: PrintWatcher
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted dashboard for monitoring 3D printers from a single web interface. Connects to Prusa Printers via PrusaLink or any 3D printer that supports OctoPrint via OctoPrint, displaying real-time status, HTTP and RTSP camera feeds, temperatures, print progress, and more via Server-Sent Events.
Features include a full File Manager with thumbnails and one-click reprint, print history with per-print material/filament stats, Pushover notifications, smart plug power control (Tasmota via direct HTTP or MQTT, or PSU Control), print control (pause/resume/cancel), and PrusaSlicer/OrcaSlicer print-host integration.
Open the web UI, add your printers, and you're set. No config files needed.
RTSP decoding uses FFmpeg, included in the image. Camera connections are outbound; no RTSP port mapping is needed.
Web interface: http://Unraid_IP:8086

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the PrintWatcher database, settings, and staged slicer uploads
